test_cases.title: Applicant's signed-in session reports the time it has left
acs: DERIVED: Applicant's signed-in session reports the time it has left - features/error-handling/error-handling.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page
steps.expected: The Home page is displayed with the D2R2 menu

steps.action: Request GET /Session/Status while signed in
steps.expected: The request returns HTTP 200 with JSON

steps.action: Check the JSON response
steps.expected: authenticated is true and remainingSeconds is greater than 0

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant sees the application error page
acs: DERIVED: Applicant sees the application error page - features/error-handling/error-handling.feature:12

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the application error page directly in the browser
steps.expected: The page with the heading "An error has occurred" is displayed

steps.action: Check the page that is displayed
steps.expected: The application error page is displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible

test_cases.title: Applicant's page carries the session warning and expiry dialogs without showing them
acs: DERIVED: Applicant's page carries the session warning and expiry dialogs without showing them - features/error-handling/error-handling.feature:17

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page
steps.expected: The Home page is displayed with the D2R2 menu

steps.action: Check the Extend session? dialog
steps.expected: The dialog exists in the page but is not displayed

steps.action: Check the Session expired dialog
steps.expected: The dialog exists in the page but is not displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant opens the application error page and confirms the error state is visible
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the application error page and confirms the error state is visible - features/error-handling/error-handling.feature:23

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the application error page directly in the browser
steps.expected: The page with the heading "An error has occurred" is displayed

steps.action: Check the page that is displayed
steps.expected: The application error page is displayed

steps.action: Check the page after it loads
steps.expected: The application error page stays displayed and does not redirect

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant's session cannot be extended without an antiforgery token
acs: DERIVED: Applicant's session cannot be extended without an antiforgery token - features/error-handling/error-handling.feature:29

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page
steps.expected: The Home page is displayed with the D2R2 menu

steps.action: Send POST /Session/Extend without an antiforgery token
steps.expected: The request is sent

steps.action: Check the response
steps.expected: The response is HTTP 400 and the session is not extended

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed
